text_en: Thus says the Lord : Maintain justice, and do what is right, for soon my salvation will come, and my deliverance be revealed.
text_cn: 上主这样说：“你们应当持守公道，履行正义，因为我的救恩就要来到，我的正义就要出现。”

text_en: Happy is the mortal who does this, the one who holds it fast, who keeps the sabbath, not profaning it, and refrains from doing any evil.
text_cn: 遵守安息日而不予以亵渎，防范自己的手而不做恶事，行这事的人，与固守此道的人子，是有福的。

text_en: Do not let the foreigner joined to the Lord say, “The Lord will surely separate me from his people”; and do not let the eunuch say, “I am just a dry tree. ”
text_cn: 归依上主的异邦人不应说：“上主必将我由他的民族中分别出来！”阉人也不应说：“看！我是一棵枯树！”

text_en: For thus says the Lord : To the eunuchs who keep my sabbaths, who choose the things that please me and hold fast my covenant,
text_cn: 因为上主这样说：“对那些遵守我的安息日，拣选我所悦意的和固守我盟约的阉人，

text_en: I will give, in my house and within my walls, a monument and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that shall not be cut off.
text_cn: 我要在我的屋内，在我的墙垣内，赐给他们比子女还好的记念碑和美名，我要赐给他们一个永久不能泯灭的名字。

text_en: And the foreigners who join themselves to the Lord , to minister to him, to love the name of the Lord , and to be his servants, all who keep the sabbath, and do not profane it, and hold fast my covenant—
text_cn: 至于那些归依上主，事奉他，爱慕上主的名，作他的仆人，又都遵守安息日而不予以亵渎，并固守我盟约的异邦人，

text_en: these I will bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer; their burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples.
text_cn: 我要领他们上我的圣山，使他们在我祈祷的殿里欢乐，他们的全燔祭和牺牲在我的祭坛上要蒙受悦纳，因为我的殿宇将称为万民的祈祷所。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord God , who gathers the outcasts of Israel, I will gather others to them besides those already gathered.
text_cn: 这是聚集四散的以色列民的吾主上主的断语：“我还要召集其他民族归于已聚集的人。”

text_en: All you wild animals, all you wild animals in the forest, come to devour!
text_cn: 田间的一切走兽，林中的一切野兽，你们都来吞噬吧！

text_en: Israel’s sentinels are blind, they are all without knowledge; they are all silent dogs that cannot bark; dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.
text_cn: 我民族的守望者都是瞎子，什么也看不清：都是哑巴狗，不能叫唤，只会作梦，偃卧，贪睡。

text_en: The dogs have a mighty appetite; they never have enough. The shepherds also have no understanding; they have all turned to their own way, to their own gain, one and all.
text_cn: 他们又是贪食的狗，总不知足；都是什么也不明了的牧人，只顾自己的道路，各求各自的利益。

text_en: “Come, ” they say, “let us get wine; let us fill ourselves with strong drink. And tomorrow will be like today, great beyond measure. ”
text_cn: “来吧！我去拿酒，让我们痛饮美酒；明天如今天一样，并且更要丰盛。”
